description: Victorian Water Accounts Water Supply Summaries is a dataset listed in Victorian Government Data Directory (discover.data.vic.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Water and Catchments. There are 18 water corporations that provide a range of services to Victorian towns and systems. The water supply accounts on this site track water from the time it moves from a waterway, an aquifer or other source to the time it is delivered to a customer or another destination. Coverage: Victoria. The portal files it under the publisher Water and Catchments. Its tags are Water Usage, environment, water supply. It offers 2 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-10-30 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-au-vic-portal.
